# --asserts--

`countWords` musi zwrócić `Map`.

```javascript
tryCatch(countWords(["a"]) instanceof Map);
```

`countWords(["red", "blue", "red", "green", "red"])` musi zmapować `"red"` na `3`.

```javascript
tryCatch(countWords(["red", "blue", "red", "green", "red"]).get("red") === 3);
```

`countWords(["red", "blue", "red", "green", "red"])` musi mieć `3` pary.

```javascript
tryCatch(countWords(["red", "blue", "red", "green", "red"]).size === 3);
```

`countWords([])` musi mieć `0` par.

```javascript
tryCatch(countWords([]).size === 0);
```

# --solutions--

```javascript
function countWords(words) {
  let counts = new Map();
  for (const word of words) {
    if (counts.has(word)) {
      counts.set(word, counts.get(word) + 1);
    } else {
      counts.set(word, 1);
    }
  }
  return counts;
}
```
